_comment: Copy this file to /config/config.json on your NAS. Remove all _comment keys.

auth._comment: Admin UI login. Generate password_hash with: python3 -c "import hashlib; print(hashlib.sha256('yourpassword'.encode()).hexdigest())"

telegram._comment: Optional. Create a bot via @BotFather, get chat_id via @userinfobot

xtream._comment: The Xtream Codes API base URL that Xtream clients (TiviMate, Sparkle, etc.) should connect to

plex._comment: Optional. Enables Plex username resolution for viewer tracking. Get token from app.plex.tv/desktop → Account → XML API.

filters._comment: Only load channels from these M3U group-title values. Leave empty array to load all.

epg._comment: EPG XML sources. ttl_hours = how long to cache. fallback_synthetic = generate basic EPG if no source available.

channel_merges._comment: Merge duplicate channels across providers. Key = canonical name, value = list of aliases.

channel_renames._comment: Rename channels as they appear in the admin UI and M3U output.

provider_colors._comment: Optional colour coding per provider name in the admin UI.

channel_assignments._comment: Force a channel to always use a specific provider. Key = channel name, value = provider name.
